meaning.vi: (Bắc Mỹ, thông tục) Một con rận.

meaning.en: (North America, colloquial, childish, usually plural) Any germ or contaminant, real or imagined, especially from the opposite gender (for pre-pubescent children).
meaning.vi: (Bắc Mỹ, thông tục, trẻ con, thường là số nhiều) Bất kỳ vi trùng hoặc chất gây ô nhiễm nào, thực hoặc tưởng tượng, đặc biệt là từ người khác giới (đối với trẻ em trước tuổi dậy thì).

meaning.en: (rare) A nest-building female American Coot (counterpart to cooter).
meaning.vi: (hiếm) Một con American Coot cái đang xây tổ (bản đối chiếu với cooter).

sentences.en: Duke Ellington's Tutti for Cootie gyrates around a walking bass core, building up to some swinging horns for its conclusion.

sentences.en: And the man is cootie eye fish, see what eats, also have even a bowel movement!

sentences.en: Something about his rubbery features and squeaky voice trigger my cootie detector.

sentences.en: After igniting mosquito-repellent incense, hang on wormy plant, plastic film seals reoccupy plant and flowerpot, after 1 hour, all aphid, red spider, powdery cootie is eliminated completely.

sentences.en: Well if it is from a swirly, there something I can do. Okay, circle, circle, dot, dot, now you have a cootie shot!
